description: Add a new tab (sheet) to an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet. Use sheets_create to make a whole new spreadsheet file; use this to add a tab inside one. Returns the new tab's sheetId and title.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

headers.description: Optional header row values written to row 1 of the new tab, e.g., ["Name", "Email", "Date"]

name: gws-mcp__sheets_add_tab
